document.abstract: This videotape visually describes a High Resolution Switching and Distribution System installed at Ames Research Center, Moffett Field, California. The equipment is located in the “FLIGHT AND GUIDANCE SIMULATOR” building. The original motion simulator was first operational in 1969.

authors.affiliation: NASA-Ames Research Center Moffett Field, CA
authors.bio: Patric L. Lewis is Research Engineer at Ames Research Center, 213–2, Moffett Field, California 94022. He graduated from Los Angeles State. Mr. Lewis joined A.R.C. in 1958, and is responsible for audio and video systems for the research facilities.

authors.bio: Mr. Good graduated from Montana State University in 1963 with a BS Degree in Film and Television. He has since specialized in the design of television communication systems that are human engineered to the needs of the user. As owner of Television Systems Services in Redwood City, California, his firm has designed and constructed many sophisticated communications for research, governmental and industry requirements. Mr. Good is now involved in design and implementation of remotely controlled Low Power Public Broadcasting Facilities for smaller unserved communities throughout the western United States.
